reporting-org.narrative: European Commission - Directorate-General for International Partnerships

title.narrative: Empowering Voices for Inclusive Development: Strengthening CSOs from Uzbekistan working with women and youth

description.narrative:
Overall Objective

To contribute to strengthening the role of local Civil Society Organisations (CSOs) as governance and development actors in Uzbekistan.

Specific Objective 1:

To increase the capacities of 15 local CSOs in Samarkand, Namangan and Tashkent working with PLWH (people living with HIV) and people affected by HIV with a view of performing their role as independent development actors more effectively.

Specific Objective 2:

To address stigma and discrimination of PLWH and people affected by HIV (with focus on women and youth) through coordinated actions by CSOs working through a multilevel approach.
